note: P1-a 最小实验：人工核对案例集。gold 为人工标注（该文档是否真正回答该子问题）。intent 标注预期失误模式：tp=true positive 基线, fn=预期漏检(同义改写/行话), fp=预期伪相关(主题词重叠/缩写碰撞/词面诱饵), noise=无关。

cases.title: KV Caching Explained for LLM Inference
cases.snippet: The key-value cache stores attention keys and values for previous tokens during autoregressive inference, so self-attention need not recompute them at each step.

cases.title: Memoizing past attention states in decoder-only models
cases.snippet: Instead of recomputing intermediate projections at every generation step, serving engines memoize them, trading extra accelerator memory for lower latency.

cases.title: Best gaming GPUs by memory size: the 2024 VRAM tier list
cases.snippet: We compare GPU memory across graphics cards and explain why GPU memory matters for gaming and which card to buy.

cases.title: Why KV cache memory grows with sequence length and batch size
cases.snippet: KV cache memory scales linearly with tokens and batch size; for long contexts it becomes the dominant GPU memory bottleneck in LLM serving.

cases.title: The hidden memory wall of autoregressive serving
cases.snippet: Per-token intermediate states accumulate with context length and quickly exhaust HBM on accelerator cards during long-generation workloads.

cases.title: MQL: advanced query optimization techniques for databases
cases.snippet: Multi-query planning reduces redundant computation across similar queries by grouping shared subplans.

cases.title: Grouped-Query Attention and PagedAttention explained
cases.snippet: GQA and MQA share key-value heads across query groups; PagedAttention pages the KV cache into blocks to cut memory waste.

cases.title: Cutting the memory bill of large-model serving
cases.snippet: Sharing attention heads and compressing cached token states are the two main levers providers use to fit long contexts on one card.

cases.title: KV cache: what it is and why it dominates GPU memory
cases.snippet: An introduction to the key-value cache mechanism and its linear memory growth with context length during inference.

cases.title: Cache basics: CPU caches and in-memory key-value stores
cases.snippet: What is a cache? Key value stores, in-memory caching patterns for web applications, and cache invalidation strategies.

cases.title: 8-bit quantization of cached states in inference
cases.snippet: Quantizing the KV cache to int8 roughly halves its memory footprint with minor accuracy loss, a common serving optimization.

cases.title: 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics: Hopfield and Hinton
cases.snippet: The prize was awarded for foundational discoveries about artificial neural networks and machine learning.
